description: CANCELS an active subscription — stops all future charges. This MODIFIES live data. A `cancellation_reason` is required. Recharge REST: POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel with JSON body { cancellation_reason, cancellation_reason_comments? }. Returns { subscription }.

cancellation_reason_comments.description: Optional free-text detail about the cancellation.

name: recharge_cancel_subscription
title: Cancel subscription
